title: Dashboard approval action preserves canonical approval events
notes: Reuses the approval.approved-patch replay bundle as dashboard action evidence because dashboard approval resolution writes the same canonical ApprovalResolved event and replay does not persist action-origin metadata.

baseline_history.rationale: Promoted for GBX-722 as the replay-representable dashboard approval action contract: canonical approval events and resumed tool execution, with live route behavior covered by web integration tests.
